Air,Ⓒs.Ⓓvyoman n., AkASaH SaM, naBas n., vihAyas n.; ‘to take the a(ir)’ vAtamAsev 1 A; ‘take a(ir)’ prakASatAM gam 1 P.
Ⓑ
 2 vAyuH, vAtaH, samIraRaH.
Ⓑ
 3 tAlaH, rAgaH, mUrCanA.
Ⓑ
 4 rUpaM, AkAraH, mudrA; ‘with a dignified a(ir)’ sagOravAkAreRa; ‘a(ir) of conceit’ avalepamudrA; ‘with the a(ir) of one who is offended’ nikftamivAtmAnaM saMdarSya.
Ⓑ
 5 gati f., viDi m., prakAraH, rUpaM; ‘through a(ir)’ vihAyasA, naBovartmanA; ‘to build castles in the a(ir)’ gaganakusumAni ci 5 U; ‘a(ir)-balloon’ AkASayAnaM, vyomayAnaM; ‘a(ir)-bladder’ vAyukozaH; ‘a(ir)-hole’ vAtAyanaM, gavAkzaH, jAlaM; ‘a(ir)-born’, ‘aerial’, AkASaja; AkASasTa, naBaHsTa.
Ⓝ[Air]y,Ⓒa.ⒹvAyava (GI f.), vAyumaya (yI f.).
Ⓑ
 2 suvAta, pravAta; ‘a(iry) place’ pravAtaM; pravAtaSayanaM ‘a bed in a(iry) place (in the current of wind)’.
Ⓑ
 3 asAra, Palgu, Kapuzpavat ind.
ⓃAeronaut,Ⓒs.ⒹvEmAnikaH.
